_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 3 — IAS 19 / RJ 271 employee-benefit pension accounting. Six new schemas (PensionPlan, ActuarialValuation, PensionMovement, PensionAssumptionSensitivity, PensionAssetDetail, PensionDisclosureTabel) declaring the defined-benefit (PUC) and defined-contribution measurement, roll-forward, sensitivity, fair-value asset breakdown and jaarrekening disclosure surface entirely as declarative metadata per ADR-031: schema fields + x-openregister-lifecycle (draft → approved → locked on ActuarialValuation, draft → active → terminated on PensionPlan) + x-openregister-aggregations (roll-forward closing balances, sensitivity deltas, disclosure-table generation). The lifecycle preconditions that require cross-field / cross-schema completeness checks the declarative requires: clause cannot yet express are referenced as OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\PensionIas19Guard::<method> (ADR-031 exception path; fail-closed; real OpenRegister ObjectService API per ADR-022). DB plans MUST carry methodology=PUC (REQ-PEN-001); DC plans are blocked from DBO/sensitivity workflows (REQ-PEN-008); discount rate is flagged when sourced from government bonds (REQ-PEN-002); OCI remeasurements are non-recycling (REQ-PEN-004). Seed objects ship two pension plans (NL Standard DB Regeling, NL Standard DC Regeling) and one sensitivity template per design.md; operators customise per administration on first use. No PHP actuarial calculation service is authored.

PensionPlan.title: Pension Plan
PensionPlan.description: Regeling description for an IAS 19 / RJ 271 employee-benefit pension plan: plan type (DB/DC/CDC/hybrid), accrual, eligibility, provider, governance, participant counts and the optional HRMQ deelnemersbestand link (REQ-PEN-001, REQ-PEN-008, REQ-PEN-010). DB plans drive full PUC measurement; DC plans get light disclosure only.

planType.description: Plan classification. DB drives full PUC measurement; DC gets light disclosure per IAS 19 §53 (REQ-PEN-001, REQ-PEN-008).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (NL default for this spec).

funded.description: Whether the plan has segregated plan assets (REQ-PEN-003).

provider.description: Provider name (e.g. pensioenfonds, verzekeraar, eigen beheer).

providerLEI.description: Legal Entity Identifier of the institutional provider.

eligibilityRules.description: Eligibility criteria (e.g. all employees age 21+ with >1 year service).

accrualRate.description: Annual DB accrual rate as a fraction of pensioengrondslag (e.g. 0.01875 for 1.875%) (REQ-PEN-001).

pensionableSalaryDefinition.description: Definition of salary used for accrual (REQ-PEN-001).
pensionableSalaryDefinition.example: Bruto jaarsalaris inclusief vaste toeslagen, minus AOW-franchise

linkedHrmqGroup.description: Optional reference to an HRMQ pension-administration group for annual deelnemersbestand validation (REQ-PEN-010). The HRMQ contract is captured declaratively in the PensionPlan x-openregister-hrmq-roster-source block (Task 19).

linkedProvisionId.description: Optional FK to the bookkeeping-voorzieningen-claims Provision record that carries the cumulative DBO on the balance sheet. When set, the voorzieningen-claims provision-closure flow consumes the latest PensionMovement.dboClosing for the linked plan and updates the provision balance accordingly (REQ-PEN-003 — pension provision linkage). Null when voorzieningen-claims is not yet provisioned in the administration; the linkage falls back to the standard DBO balance-sheet line.

governanceDocument.description: File URI to the regeling / governance charter, archived in docudesk (ADR-022 — no app-local storage).

notes.description: Free-text notes on plan history, amendments, governance.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this plan belongs to; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-PEN-001).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Regeling being registered; plan type and accrual under review.

active.label: Active
active.description: Live plan accruing benefits; actuarial valuations may be recorded against it (REQ-PEN-001).

terminated.label: Terminated
terminated.description: Plan ended; only run-off obligation remains.

activate.label: Activate plan
activate.description: Activate once the plan type, framework and (for DB) accrual rate + pensionable-salary definition are complete (REQ-PEN-001).

pause.label: Pause accrual
pause.description: Suspend further accrual while retaining the obligation.

resume.label: Resume accrual
resume.description: Resume accrual on a paused plan.

terminate.label: Terminate plan
terminate.description: Terminate the plan; only run-off obligation remains.

ActuarialValuation.title: Actuarial Valuation
ActuarialValuation.description: Per-balansdatum measurement of a DB plan's defined-benefit obligation (DBO) and plan assets, with the actuarial assumptions and actuaris sign-off (REQ-PEN-001, REQ-PEN-002, REQ-PEN-005). Projected Unit Credit (PUC) methodology is mandatory for DB plans (REQ-PEN-001); the discount rate must be market-referenced and is flagged when a government-bond source is used (REQ-PEN-002). netPensionLiability = dboGross − planAssetsFairValue + assetCeilingApplied (IFRIC 14, REQ-PEN-005).

plan.description: FK to the PensionPlan being valued (REQ-PEN-001).

actuaryCertificationNumber.description: Registration / certification identifier of the actuaris.

methodology.description: Measurement methodology. MUST be PUC for DB plans per IAS 19 §67 (REQ-PEN-001); DC for contribution-only plans (REQ-PEN-008).

discountRateGovernmentBondFlag.description: True when the discount rate is sourced from government bonds; surfaces the IAS 19 §83 warning for accountant review (REQ-PEN-002). Not an error — flagged, not blocked.

withdrawalRate.description: Expected employee withdrawal / resignation rate, percent.

planAssetsFairValue.description: Fair value of plan assets in EUR (REQ-PEN-003).

assetCeilingApplied.description: Asset-ceiling adjustment per IFRIC 14 when overfunded; negative reduces a net asset (REQ-PEN-005).

netPensionLiability.description: Computed dboGross − planAssetsFairValue + assetCeilingApplied; positive = net liability, negative = net asset (REQ-PEN-005).

valuationReport.description: File URI to the full actuarial report, archived in docudesk (ADR-022).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-PEN-002).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Actuarial inputs being entered (DBO, assumptions, plan assets).

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Accountant has approved the discount-rate assumption and methodology; ready for roll-forward and disclosure (REQ-PEN-002).

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Locked after the jaarrekening is finalised. Immutable; corrections are journalised as amendments, never deletions.

approve.label: Approve valuation
approve.description: Approve once the discount-rate assumption is accountant-signed and (for DB plans) methodology=PUC (REQ-PEN-001, REQ-PEN-002).

lock.label: Lock valuation
lock.description: Lock the approved valuation when the jaarrekening is finalised; the HRMQ roster must be reconciled before lock (REQ-PEN-010).

reopen.label: Return to draft
reopen.description: Return an approved-but-not-locked valuation to draft for correction.

PensionMovement.title: Pension Movement
PensionMovement.description: Per-period roll-forward of DBO and plan assets, split into the three IAS 19R buckets: service + past service + settlement (P&L), net interest (P&L) and actuarial gain/loss (OCI, non-recycling per IAS 19 §122) (REQ-PEN-003, REQ-PEN-004, REQ-PEN-009). dboClosing, planAssetsClosing, netPensionMovementPL and netPensionMovementOCI are computed roll-forward fields. Past service cost from a plan amendment is posted directly to P&L on the amendment date (REQ-PEN-009).

pastServiceCost.description: Past service cost from a plan amendment, posted directly to P&L on the amendment date (REQ-PEN-009). Negative when a benefit reduction.

netInterestCost.description: Net interest = discount rate × opening net pension liability (P&L) (REQ-PEN-003).

actuarialLossGainDBO.description: Total actuarial change on DBO (OCI). Negative = gain, positive = loss on the obligation (REQ-PEN-003, REQ-PEN-004).

dueToDemographicChanges.description: Portion of the DBO actuarial change due to mortality/disability/withdrawal (OCI).

dueToFinancialChanges.description: Portion due to discount-rate / inflation change (OCI).

dueToExperienceAdjustments.description: Portion due to actual vs assumed experience (OCI).

dboClosing.description: Computed dboOpening + serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost + actuarialLossGainDBO − benefitsPaid (REQ-PEN-003).

expectedReturnOnAssets.description: Expected return = discount rate × opening assets (EUR).

employerContributions.description: Contributions paid by the employer (EUR). For DC plans this is the only pension cost recognised (REQ-PEN-008).

planAssetsClosing.description: Computed planAssetsOpening + expectedReturnOnAssets + actuarialGainLossAssets + employerContributions + employeeContributions − benefitsPaidFromAssets (REQ-PEN-003).

netPensionMovementPL.description: Computed serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost − gainOnSettlement; total P&L charge (REQ-PEN-003).

netPensionMovementOCI.description: Computed actuarialLossGainDBO − actuarialGainLossAssets; total OCI remeasurement, non-recycling (REQ-PEN-004).

linkedJournalEntries.description: References to GL journal entries created from this movement (T2 GL integration).

notes.description: Free-text narrative on the period (e.g. plan amendment, rate change) (REQ-PEN-009).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.

pensionRollForward.description: Declarative shape of the per-period DBO + plan-asset roll-forward (REQ-PEN-003). dboClosing carries the opening balance plus all movement buckets; planAssetsClosing rolls the asset side; netPensionMovementPL and netPensionMovementOCI partition the period charge into the disjoint P&L and OCI buckets per IAS 19R. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the prior-period carry, the same arithmetic is recomputed from the prior PensionMovement closing balance + current ActuarialValuation via the real ObjectService API.

dboClosing.expression: dboOpening + serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost + actuarialLossGainDBO - benefitsPaid

planAssetsClosing.expression: planAssetsOpening + expectedReturnOnAssets + actuarialGainLossAssets + employerContributions + employeeContributions - benefitsPaidFromAssets

x-openregister-posting-recipe.description: Declarative GL posting recipe for PensionMovement, consumed by the T1 bookkeeping-general-ledger JournalEntry materialiser (REQ-PEN-003, REQ-PEN-004, REQ-JE-007). Each bucket maps to a `bookkeeping-general-ledger` JournalEntry whose materialised GLTransaction posts the period charge to the configured chart-of-accounts range. The recipe is declarative: the JournalEntry orchestrator reads it on PensionMovement transition to `posted` and emits one JournalEntry per non-zero bucket; ids land in `PensionMovement.linkedJournalEntries`. Account ranges follow the standard Dutch SBR/RGS bookkeeping hierarchy (4xxx personeelslasten, 6xxx financiële lasten, 8xxx OCI/eigen vermogen) and may be overridden per administration via the chart-of-accounts mapping (REQ-COA-002).

buckets.name: serviceCost
buckets.description: IAS 19 service cost + past service cost - gain on settlement → personeelslasten (REQ-PEN-003 P&L bucket 1).

buckets.name: netInterest
buckets.description: IAS 19 net interest on the net pension liability → financiële lasten (REQ-PEN-003 P&L bucket 2).

buckets.name: remeasurementOCI
buckets.description: Actuarieel resultaat (DBO + assets) → OCI account (REQ-PEN-003 OCI bucket 3); marked non-recycling per REQ-PEN-004 so the GL engine MUST refuse any later JournalEntry that moves this balance to a P&L account.

x-openregister-deferred-tax-hint.description: Declarative deferred-tax detection hint consumed by bookkeeping-deferred-tax (REQ-DT-001). PensionMovement creates timing differences between the commercial (IFRS / RJ 271) measurement of the pension liability and its tax basis (in NL: pension provisions are typically only deductible when contributions are paid out, so the commercial provision creates a deductible temporary difference / DTA). The detector reads this hint and emits TemporaryDifference records with category=pension per fiscal period per administration; the OCI component flows to TaxProvision.recognisedInOCI per REQ-DT-009.

PensionAssumptionSensitivity.title: Pension Assumption Sensitivity
PensionAssumptionSensitivity.description: DBO sensitivity line for one assumption delta on one ActuarialValuation per IAS 19 §145 (REQ-PEN-006). Each DB valuation generates eight lines: discount rate ±0.5pp, salary growth ±0.5pp, mortality ±1yr, inflation ±0.5pp. Records the effect on DBO, service cost and (optionally) net interest.

direction.description: Delta applied, e.g. +0.5pp / -0.5pp for rates, +1yr / -1yr for mortality (REQ-PEN-006).

effectOnDBO.description: Impact on DBO in EUR; sign matches the direction's effect (REQ-PEN-006).

effectOnServiceCost.description: Impact on service cost in EUR (REQ-PEN-006).

effectOnNetInterest.description: Impact on net interest cost in EUR.

notes.description: Free-text explanation (e.g. discount-rate rise lowers DBO).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.

pensionSensitivityDeltas.description: Declarative shape of the per-assumption sensitivity recomputation (REQ-PEN-006). For each of the eight standard deltas the base DBO + service cost are recomputed and the difference stored as effectOnDBO / effectOnServiceCost. When the engine cannot recompute the actuarial base, the actuaris-supplied effect is entered directly and validated for completeness (eight lines per DB valuation).

PensionAssetDetail.title: Pension Asset Detail
PensionAssetDetail.description: Plan-asset breakdown by category with the IFRS 13 fair-value level (1 quoted / 2 observable / 3 unobservable) for one ActuarialValuation (REQ-PEN-007). The per-valuation category fair values must sum to ActuarialValuation.planAssetsFairValue.

fairValue.description: Fair value of assets in this category in EUR (REQ-PEN-007).

level.description: IFRS 13 fair-value level: 1 quoted, 2 observable, 3 unobservable (REQ-PEN-007).

notes.description: Free-text notes (e.g. real estate at indexed cost, revaluation pending).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.

PensionDisclosureTabel.title: Pension Disclosure Table
PensionDisclosureTabel.description: Auto-generated jaarrekening disclosure table per IAS 19 §135–149 for a plan on a balansdatum (REQ-PEN-007, REQ-PEN-008). tableContent holds the structured disclosure (assumptions, DBO movement, asset movement, P&L + OCI summary, asset breakdown by category + fair-value level, duration, expected employer contribution) suitable for jaarrekening notes; for DC plans it carries only the contribution amount + regeling summary (REQ-PEN-008).

tableContent.description: Full disclosure table as structured JSON, auto-generated from PensionMovement + PensionAssetDetail + PensionAssumptionSensitivity records; renderable as Markdown/HTML for jaarrekening notes (REQ-PEN-007). For DC plans, only contribution + regeling summary (REQ-PEN-008).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.

pensionDisclosureGeneration.description: Declarative shape of the disclosure-table generation (REQ-PEN-007). Consumes the completed PensionMovement (DBO + asset movement, P&L/OCI split), PensionAssetDetail (category + fair-value level) and PensionAssumptionSensitivity (eight sensitivity lines) records for the plan on the valuation date and emits a single PensionDisclosureTabel with all IAS 19 §135–149 line items. When the engine cannot template the merge, the same structure is built from the source records via the real ObjectService API.

objects.eligibilityRules: Alle medewerkers vanaf 21 jaar met meer dan 1 jaar dienstverband
objects.pensionableSalaryDefinition: Bruto jaarsalaris inclusief vaste toeslagen, minus AOW-franchise
objects.notes: Voorbeeld defined-benefit regeling (PUC verplicht). Pas aan per administratie bij eerste gebruik.
Voorbeeld defined-contribution regeling (lichte disclosure per IAS 19 §53). Geen DBO/PUC/gevoeligheidsanalyse.
Sjabloon: vul het werkelijke DBO-effect in uit het actuariële rapport (disconteringsvoet +0.5pp verlaagt de DBO).
